title: Better End Progression
description: This adds new Hearts, just like the Heart of the Sea, to various structures around the world. Combine these to make the Heart of the End, which can be combined with many other treasures to make an Eye of Ender. Subsequent eyes are much easier to make!
body:
![BEP logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qBPh34fb/images/f678fe6e4d81f25b592eac438b721f619bbd76cd.png)

The Eye of Ender can now be crafted by combining these items:
- Heart of the End (see below)
- Warden Rib (drops when killing a warden)
- Prismarine Crown (see below)
- Nether Star
- Wither Rose
- Totem of Undying
- Torchflower
- Echo Shard
- Netherite Scrap

The Heart of the end can be crafted from the following hearts:
- Heart of the Sea
- Heart of the Brute (found in Bastions)
- Heart of the Caverns (found in Mineshafts)
- Heart of the Desert (found in Desert Temples)
- Heart of the Jungle (found in Jungle Temples)
- Heart of the Ruins (found in Trail Ruins)
- Heart of the Swamp (found in Witch Huts)
- Heart of the Tundra (found in Igloo Basements)
- Heart of the Woodlands (found in Woodland Mansions)

The Prismarine Crown can be crafted by placing 3 Prismarine Scales above and to either side of a turtle helmet. Prismarine Shards are dropped by the Elder Guardian.

After you've crafted your first Eye of Ender, you can create more by combining the first one with an Ender Pearl.
